description: Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Flag is the perfect item to show your support and respect for police and law enforcement officials. Measuring 3’ X 5’, these thin blue line flags feature double stitching to prevent fraying. Made from a resilient polyester material, this law enforcement thin blue line flag is perfect to withstand outdoor climates. Show your support for law enforcement by hanging the police thin blue line flag on your porch, inside your home, or on your vehicle.
